name: Bookly
description: Bookly — A multi-tenant appointment booking platform built with Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Neon. Supports customer booking, authentication, business admin management, service scheduling, availability rules, and concurrency-safe appointment reservations.

paragraphs: Bookly is a full-stack, multi-tenant appointment booking platform. A System Owner onboards business customers ("tenants"), each Business Admin manages their own services, availability, and appointments, and End Customers browse a business's public booking page to book and cancel their own appointments.
features: Platform-wide authentication, separate from any tenant
Onboard a new business — creates the tenant and its first Business Admin account in a single transaction
List all onboarded businesses, with admin contact info and appointment counts
Enable/disable a business; a disabled business can no longer take bookings or let its admin operate
Authentication scoped to exactly one tenant

whatItDoes.text: Bookly is a full-stack, multi-tenant appointment booking platform. A System Owner onboards business customers ("tenants"), each Business Admin manages their own services, availability, and appointments, and End Customers browse a business's public booking page to book and cancel their own appointments.

requirements.text: Public booking page per business (/book/[slug]) — no login required to browse
Optional account (register/login) for a persistent booking history, or a token-based link for guest cancellation
